data.name: Kung Fu Time Travel
data.detailed_description:
This game features a comedic and political intrigue style, integrating diverse elements such as kung fu, fantasy, reasoning, suspense, and romance. Players take on the role of Wu Song, eliminating treacherous court officials one by one through strategic scheming. It presents the power struggles and intrigues between the imperial court, Liangshan, and various factions in a comedic tone, and exposes the absurd chaos and corruption of the officialdom in the Northern Song Dynasty through slapstick comedy, making players laugh until they cry.

Featuring live-action performances, the game retains the core interactive movie characteristics of multiple choices and multiple endings. All story branches adopt long-form narratives, rather than simplistic, binary short branches. At the same time, its playability is greatly enhanced with operable fighting, adventure, puzzle-solving, and case-solving segments, as well as traditional Chinese cultural elements including couplet writing, riddles, and character divination, effectively making up for the lack of gameplay in traditional interactive films. The game consists of 70 episodes in total.

data.short_description: Players assume the role of the protagonist who travels back to his previous life to change his destiny, gain love and achieve career success. The game features elements of comedy, ingenious strategies, reasoning and fantasy, with multiple choices and multiple endings.
